changelog:
**Skill now generates a standalone HTML dashboard visualizing your job application tracker data, offering charts and filterable tables from your SQLite database.**

- Produces a self-contained HTML dashboard (stat cards, Chart.js visualizations, interactive tables) from your SQLite application tracker, no server required.
- Reads "applications" from the same SQLite DB as the job-application-manager, without modifying your data.
- Visualizes statuses (Active/Interview/Offer/Rejected), status breakdown doughnut, tags bar chart, applications-by-month, pipeline funnel, and a sortable table of all applications.
- Supports chart fallbacks: if offline/Chart.js can't load, stat cards render regardless.
- Fully updates SKILL.md for new focus; removes old static assets, CSS, templates, and Python build scripts from prior Odoo/markdown report versions.
- Handles edge cases and schema detection for DB compatibility.
summary: Generates a self-contained HTML dashboard (stat cards, Chart.js charts, filterable table) from the same SQLite tracker database used by application-manager —...
